additional_info.subject: 0468454 - ID0468454-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S2 170003381] Charging issue CRM:00472000490
additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
The logs shared, belong to 2 different chargers.
First is the Y2/T3314161484001, charger ID 6cf0ZA.
BT5 temperature sensor sometimes works wrongly. We observe very high temperature values in the same second. This could indicate a problem with the temperature sensor.
Check if the plugs in the BT5 circuit are not the problem. Try to touch them while measuring the BT5 resistance (This should be done with charger OFF).
In case you find no issue with the wiring ans plugs, please proceed to replace BT5.
For the second charger MP / S2 170003381, pHAdNC.
There is no response from the backend to the request to authorize the idTag. So the session has a invalid state and is stopped. Nothing wrong here except for the lack of response from OCPP backend.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
